judge.rationale: The candidate completely failed to implement the feature in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and did not add `ajv` to `package.json`, meaning the core functionality does not exist and all new validation tests will fail. The candidate only modified documentation files, created a `.lore/dod.md` artifact, and wrote acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` (rather than the requested `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`). Furthermore, the test file uses `any` types, contains an empty placeholder test for static schema compilation caching, and uses malformed spec-link syntax that will fail the repository's `re-lint` rules. Because `docs/adding-a-tool.md` was updated without updating `example/weather-tool.ts`, the doc-block check would also fail.
